description: Agent Bookkeeping: submit the period-close records: the close with its reference, the first and last day of the period, the day the close is read on, each entry in the posting queue with its id, entry number, date, memo and status (draft, pending approval or posted), each account reconciled at close with the last day it is reconciled through, each accrual, prepaid or deferral with its account, kind, open balance, last adjustment day and the day it fully reverses or amortizes, and each recurring entry due every period with the last day it posted. The signed report gives the close, each draft or pending entry dated in the period, each account’s reconciliation against the period end, each accrual or prepaid read for an adjustment in the period and against its end, and each recurring entry read for a posting in the period, and counts them, and names a divergent close: unposted drafts left in the period, accounts unreconciled at close, stale accruals and prepaids, and missing recurring entries; then a close read before the period ends and an accrual or prepaid with no end date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No period at both ends, no accounts to reconcile, no adjustment or end day on any open accrual, or no recurring entries leaves those points unverified. Dates compare by the day and balances to the cent. This reads whether the books are ready for the period close: wever_expense-close-pack packs up one expense close, the payment, receipt and refund records of a trip or project spend, while the close check reads the books’ own period close across the posting queue, reconciliations, accruals and recurring entries. Verdict bookkeeping_close_divergent, bookkeeping_close_partial, bookkeeping_close_unverified or bookkeeping_close_consistent. POST /api/bookkeeping-close-check. Reads the bookkeeping records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the books as supplied only: it never posts or edits an entry, never moves money or pays a bill, never files anything with any authority and gives no tax advice, which stay with the business, its bookkeeper and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Bookkeeping reads a business’s own books for internal consistency and against the records they should agree with: a general-ledger extract, a bank reconciliation, journal entries, a chart of accounts, a period close, the accounts payable ledger, a payroll register and the accounts receivable ledger, each against its own debits and credits, the source totals supplied, the bank statement and the ledger balance, the open period, the posting queue and recurring entries, or the ledger postings and pay schedule it should agree with. The family reads bookkeeping, the record a business keeps of its own transactions in its ledger and journals, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-bookkeeping-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-bookkeeping/.
